name: Count Dooku
bannerMiniatureIdeas: The crest of House Serenno mounted on a Separatist battle standard, draped in crimson velvet
Count Dooku's curved-hilt lightsaber crossed with a CIS hex emblem on a bronze plinth
A miniature Geonosis arena gate flanked by two droideka shields, topped with Darth Tyranus sigil
vehicleSuggestions: Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop — Dooku's solar sailer from Geonosis
Flitknot Speeder Bike — personal transport used during the Geonosis escape
Providence-class Dreadnought — flagship of the Separatist fleet under Dooku's command

factionTrait.name: Tactician Champion
factionTrait.text: A tactician moves the turn token +1 step when they make a claim action.

uniqueTraits.name: Fallen Lord
uniqueTraits.text: When Count Dooku is knocked out, your opponent may not move him.

ultimate.name: Kill Him Now
ultimate.text: Knock out an enemy model within range. It does not award you any steps on the battle ladder.

plotSkills.name: Force Lightning
plotSkills.text: Count Dooku may use this skill as a bonus action. An enemy model within range gains {protection_blight}.

plotSkills.name: Force Pull
plotSkills.text: Hit Effect: Move target up to 1 hex toward Count Dooku.

clashSkills.name: Force Crush
clashSkills.text: Move one objective hex within range 1 hex toward Count Dooku onto an empty non-objective hex. Models on the objective hex move with it.

traits.name: Escort Formation
traits.text: At the end of the Droidekas' activation, move up to 2 small follower models within 2 hexes of a Droideka, 1 hex towards that Droideka.

plotSkills.name: Roll Out
plotSkills.text: Move each Droideka within 4 hexes of Count Dooku up to 2 hexes.

clashSkills.name: Complete Annihilation
clashSkills.text: If both Droidekas are adjacent to the same enemy banner, remove the banner from the battlefield.

clashSkills.name: Twin Repeating Blasters
clashSkills.text: Make 3 hit rolls instead of 1. For each hit, this skill has +2 {damage_die}.
